# Fondazione Prada Announces New Venice Exhibition

**Fondazione Prada** has announced a new exhibition at **Ca' Corner della Regina** in Venice, to take place across four weeks this spring.

Titled ***Padiglione***,the exhibition will be on view from **9 to 23 May 2026**, during the opening weeks of the **60th Venice Biennale** (actually the 61st edition).

Artists participating in *Padiglione* include Meriem Bennani, Cao Fei, Theaster Gates, Liam Gillick, Carsten Höller, Natascha Sadr Haghighian, Taryn Simon, Hito Steyerl, and Cerith Wyn Evans.

The exhibition's title, *Padiglione*, refers to the Italian word for 'pavilion'—a reference to the unique and historic structure of the Venice Biennale.

*Padiglione* is curated by Rem Koolhaas and Ippolito Pestellini Laziosi.

</tool_response>

The exhibition at Fondazione Prada (Ca' Corner della Regina) in Venice from May 9 to May 23, 2026 was titled **Padiglione**, curated by Rem Koolhaas and Ippolito Pestellini Laziosi.

FINAL: Padiglione
